typography.strategy: The Anti-Default Rule. Avoid Inter. Use Manrope with extreme weight contrast.
typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-light text-[#2B3024]
typography.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-medium text-[#2B3024]

visual enhancers.shadows: shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(43,48,36,0.06)] for a soft, floaty feel.
visual enhancers.textures: Use soft pastel solid backgrounds. Avoid aggressive noise. Keep it clean and calm.

grids.bento_grid: Use Mode B for Dashboard. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Cards must have p-6 or p-8 internal padding.
grids.mobile_stack: flex flex-col gap-4 for the quiz flow, maintaining a strict max-w-md center column.

layouts.philosophy: Mobile-first, Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2x spacing.
layouts.containers: Max-width wrapper (max-w-md mx-auto) for the core app quiz flow. Results can expand to max-w-4xl.
layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align text for readability in cards, center-align hero.

motion.quiz_transitions: Slide horizontally. exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}, initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}, animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
motion.reveal_animation: Satisfying stagger reveal for routine results. Parent staggerChildren: 0.15. Cards scale up (0.95 -> 1) and fade in.
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg. Active states scale down to 0.98.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #2B3024 meets APCA standards. Do not use fully transparent overlays.

media.strategy: Soft, calm photography. Organic textures. Pill-shaped image masks for profile or decorative elements.

3d libraries.strategy: None. Keep the interface 2D, flat, clean, and fast. 'Simplicity above all else' overrides unnecessary 3D.

hero_background.description: Pastel bottles on crumpled fabric. Use as a soft hero image.

skin_texture.description: Person applying glowing serum. Use as a soft avatar or atmospheric card background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Run: yarn add framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge
Run: npx shadcn-ui@latest add button card progress form input label
Replace generic default fonts. Add Manrope from Google Fonts in index.html.
Implement the app as a single-page flow or use react-router. The quiz must feel like a seamless app experience, not multiple page reloads.
The Result Screen must be visually distinct. Use 'bg-[#D2D9C5]' (soft sage) for the background of the results page to signal a 'successful transition' from the quiz.
Do NOT use pure #000000. All darks must be '#2B3024'.
Ensure the hero image has a subtle overlay if text is placed on it, or place text on a solid pastel background.
Quiz options must be large clickable cards. Not small radio buttons.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and quiz option cards.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) cautiously.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭) for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
Never use placeholder URLs for images.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Every screen must have exactly ONE primary action.
Eliminate feature creep: focus entirely on the core user journey from landing -> quiz -> routine.
Thumb-friendly tap targets are mandatory for a mobile-first experience. Min height for touch targets: 48px.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
